## Member Search Results Code - HTML Snippet of Member Search Result Code
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000096172
This article provides a sample HTML structure for a single member displayed in the Member Search Results page.
The example includes the most commonly used HTML elements, CSS classes, and layout structure generated by the standard Brilliant Directories website theme.
This is sample HTML code of the Member Search Result Code for a single member's data, including common classes and elements.

The following HTML snippet represents the default markup for a single member search result.
